Report Description/// INCIDENT DESCRIPTION /// RECEIVED ON 2026-05-07 03:49 ET | CREATED BY MICHAEL GALANTE L'APPELANT NOUS AVISE D'UNE COLLISION ENTRE UN VÉHICULE ET UN CAMION DE TRANSPORT AU KM 16 DIRECTIONS EST DU NB-2. LE TANK À DIESEL A ÉTÉ PERCE ET A COULÉ ENTRE 200-300 GAL DE DIESEL SUR L'ASPHALTE ET LE GAZON. AUCUN COURS D'EAU NI DRAIN AFFECTER. DES BOUDINS ONT ÉTÉ PLACE POUR CONTENIR LE MATÉRIEL, ET UN CAMION ASPIRANT A ÉTÉ COMMANDER. LE NOM DE LA COMPAGNIE DE TRANSPORT EST D4 LOGISTICS. **UNOFFICIAL TRANSLATION** THE CALLER REPORTS A COLLISION BETEWEEN AND VEHICLE AND A TRACTOR-TRAILER AT KM 16 EASTBOUND ON NB-2. THE TRUCKS SADDLE TANKS HAVE BEEN PIERCED SPILLING 200-300GAL TO THE ROADWAY AND GRACE. NO DRAINS OR WATERWAYS AFFECTED. CONTAINMENT BOONS HAVE BEEN PLACED AND HAVE EFFECTIVELY CONTAINED THE SPILL. A VAC TRUCK HAS BEEN CONTRACTED TO COME AND RECOVER THE REMAINING FUEL. THE TRANSPORT COMPAGNIE IS D4 LOGISTICS. ///UPDATE UPDATE UPDATE/// THE CALLER HAS PROVIDED AN UPDATE TO THE SITUATION INDICATING THAT THE SPILL HAS MIGRATED DOWN THE HIGHWAY SHOULDER AND HAS REACHED A STORM DRAIN. A SHEEN HAS BEEN OBSERVED ON THE MADAWASKA RIVER. BOONS HAVE BEEN PLACED BY THE ACCIDENT SITE AND JUST BEFORE THE WATERCOURSE. THE CALLER HAS ALSO CONTACTED THE RP TO INDICATE THEIR RESPONSIBILITY FOR CLEANUP.

Report Description///CNUE/NEEC REPORT///// DURING AN EXERCISE YESTERDAY IN THE ST. CLAIR RIVER, CCG ER STAFF LOCATED A SUBMERGED AND ABANDONED VESSEL IN POSITION 42° 35" 53.1708" 82° 31" 51.924" THE VESSEL APPEARS TO BE A 14-16FT FIBERGLASS PLEASURE BOAT WITH AN OUTBOARD MOTOR. THE MOTOR DOES NOT HAVE ITS COVER, AND THE MACHINERY IS COVERED IN ALGAE GROWTH. NO SIGNS OF POLLUTION WERE OBSERVED. IT APPEARS AS THOUGH THE VESSEL HAS BEEN SUBMERGED FOR SOME TIME - EVIDENT BY THE ALGAE GROWTH OVER IT. THE VESSEL IS LOCATED IN ABOUT 3-4FT OF WATER AT THE EDGE OF THE NORTHERN ENTRANCE TO THE CHEMATOGAN CHANNEL OF WALPOLE ISLAND FIRST NATION. THE VESSEL APPEARED STATIONARY IN ITS CURRENT POSITION, SUBMERGED AND AGROUND IN THE MUD AND GRASS, EVEN CONSIDERING THE 1-2 KNOT CURRENT. NO IDENTIFYING MARKS WERE VISIBLE, LOCAL WALPOLE ISLAND OBSERVERS PRESENT FOR THE EXERCISE WERE UNAWARE OF THE VESSELWHEN QUESTIONED. ER STAFF WERE PRESENT AT THIS SAME LOCATION DURING AN EXERCISE IN THE SUMMER OF 2021, AND DID NOT NOTICE THIS WRECK AT THAT TIME.

properties.title: NRC Report: Sodium Hypochlorite (15% Or Less in Catch Basin near Jacksonville, FL
properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 986775 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: UNITED STATES GYPSUM CO.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 986775
Incident Time: 2011-08-22 14:00:00
Nearest City: Jacksonville, FL
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE (15% OR LESS
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: UNITED STATES GYPSUM CO.
Skytruth Analysis
SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE SOLUTION LEAKED FROM A STORAGE TANK AND INTO A COVERED CONTAINMENT. THE CONTAINMENT CONSISTS OF A CONCRETE SLAB AND CONCRETE WALLS. A LEAK DEVELOPED BETWEEN THE CONTAINMENT DRAIN VALVE PIPE AND THE CONCRETE WALL. APPROXIMATELY 650 POUNDS OF SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE ESCAPED FROM THE CONTAINMENT AND SPREAD ONTO SURROUNDING PAVEMENT. MOST OF THE CHEMICAL FLOWED INTO A NEARBY STORM DRAINAGE CATCH BASIN. THE STORM WATER DRAINAGE SYSTEM FLOWS INTO THE ST. JOHNS RIVER. THE SPILL OCCURRED BETWEEN 8/19/2011 AFTER 1700 AND 8/22/2011 BEFORE 0900. THE SPILL WAS DISCOVERED AT 0900 ON 8/22/2011. CLEAN UP ACTIVITIES ARE UNDERWAY AND CONSISTS OF RECLAIMING THE MATERIAL IN THE CONTAINMENT AND ABSORBING THE CHEMICAL ON THE SURROUNDING PAVEMENT.
